newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Omnia plans 110 million rand expansion.
newsitem.headline: Omnia plans 110 million rand expansion.

text.p: South African chemicals group Omnia Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to invest 110 million rand on developments to increase capacity, improve production efficiency and support diversification.
At the same time the fertiliser explosives and chemicals producer said it was investigating the possibility of establishing a second nitric acid plant at its Sasolburg complex.
Omnia said the major component of the new capital programme, which follows the completion of two major capital projects last year, was a 92 million rand fertiliser granulation plant.

Among other projects, the company's Intaba Chemicals division will be spending eight million rand on an aluminium trihydrate factory at Springs and 5.2 million on a blending unit at Banket in Zimbabwe.
